description: Conservative coaching prompts for discussion with a coach. These are editorial suggestions, not validated corrections for measured angles. No dosage or loading prescriptions.

activities.title: Watch the whole stride
activities.text: Review the thigh moving forward and returning beneath the body across consecutive frames. Avoid changing your technique to match a single still image.

activities.title: Review posture with your coach
activities.text: Compare the shoulder-to-hip line across the passage. Ask your coach whether the view is sufficiently side-on before discussing a posture change.

activities.title: Controlled sprint march
activities.text: If familiar and comfortable, use a relaxed march to explore alternating leg positions with your coach. Treat it as coordination practice, not a proven fix for this recording.

activities.title: Discuss step-ups
activities.text: Ask your coach whether a comfortable, controlled step-up belongs in your existing strength plan. This suggestion does not indicate a weak muscle or specify a load.

activities.title: Discuss squat practice
activities.text: Ask your coach whether familiar, comfortable squat practice belongs in your existing training. Video angles alone cannot determine exercise selection, loading, or readiness.
